performance.cpu_note: The first comparison counters were all zero; later counters occasionally jump by a coarse 15.625ms increment. These short intervals are below useful CPU accounting resolution on this Windows/JDK, so CPU cost is not quantified.

limitations: Graphical menu interactions and outbound packets were not measured with a real client.
Performance workload isolates controller timer cost; it does not measure 1200 physically placed appliances or whole-server TPS.
Folia exercises real cross-region rejection; successful and failed teleport completion are controlled, not actual successful animal teleport acceptance.
